question: COBOL is an example of _____________ generation programming language.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• COBOL is classified as a t**hird-generation programming language**, designed for **business** and **administrative** systems.
 
• COBOL stands for **"Common Business-Oriented Language"** and is primarily used for data processing in finance and government sectors.
 
• COBOL is known for its readability, using** English-like syntax**, which makes it easier for non-programmers to understand.
 
• COBOL is still widely used in legacy systems, especially in large-scale batch-processing systems for **banks** and** insurance **companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First-Generation Languages (1GL)**

 
 
• **Machine Language:** This generation involves machine-level programming, consisting of binary code (0s and 1s).
 
• Direct Hardware Interaction: Programmers write instructions that the CPU directly understands.
 
• **Example: **Binary code for early computers.
 
 
 
• **Second-Generation Languages (2GL)**
 
 
• **Assembly Language:** Uses mnemonics (symbolic code) for instructions, which are translated into machine code using an assembler.
 
• Low-Level Programming: Provides closer control over hardware, but is still difficult to work with.
 
• **Example: **Assembly Language.
 
 
 
• **Third-Generation Languages (3GL)**
 
 
• **High-Level Language: **Offers more abstraction from the hardware, allowing the programmer to focus on logic rather than machine code.
 
• Improved Readability and Portability: Code written in 3GL can run on different hardware systems with minimal changes.
 
• **Example:** COBOL, C, FORTRAN.
 
 
 
• **Fourth-Generation Languages (4GL)**
 
 
• **Application-Oriented: **These languages are designed to be more user-friendly, and often used for database queries and report generation.
 
• Minimal Programming Required: Aimed at reducing the complexity of software development by automating repetitive tasks.
 
• **Example: **SQL, MATLAB.
 
 
 
• **Fifth-Generation Languages (5GL)**
 
 
• **Logic-Based and AI-Oriented:** These languages are based on problem-solving using constraints rather than specific algorithms.
 
• AI and Expert Systems: They are used in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
 
• **Example: **Prolog, Mercury.
